entry.author: Kordia
entry.summary:
We’ve all experienced the frustration of a stream buffering during a big live event. But what if your network could self-optimise in real-time?

Alaina Hall dives into Streaming Optimisation, an AI-powered peer-to-peer network that treats the end-user experience as a "first-class citizen". By reducing churn and providing deep real-time analytics, this technology ensures New Zealanders get the broadcast-quality experience they expect on any device.

See how we’re optimising the streaming experience: 👉 https://www.kordia.co.nz/broadcast/cloud-and-ott-solutions

#Streaming #AI #UserExperience #BroadcastingTech #KordiaChats
